baseline: Frozen deployed C82, complete published official fixed validation only. No training, no model choice, and no changes to the predictions.
score: Per-band sqrt(sum of squared errors over that band's valid pixels / valid count). Group SSE divided by all valid SSE in the same band. Signed error = predicted minus true pathloss; positive means predicted received power too low.
predeclared_checks: Exact canonical clear/partial/blocked states with C76 double-rounding verified against C78 frozen uniform sites; within 2 m of partial regions or a transition in these states vs further away.

Error tail, signed over- and under-prediction, per-map bias, terrain and distance concentration, joint versus single-valid frequencies. Block-scale variance and covariance of predicted vs true textures on common valid pixels.

Diagnostic 0, global integer shift, local integer shift, local offset and joint shift/offset, same interior pixels. Estimate parameters on one checkerboard parity and score the other, then swap. This uses labels only as a diagnostic.

Re-evaluate weak-site localization and power mismatch within the C78 preselected, conservative geometry sites using actual C82 official predictions. Select examples from validation, expressly identified as illustrative.
